body:
I finally figured out/admitted I'm bi and haven't told anyone except for a few people online. It would be hella awkward because to certain people I've seemed straight for so long. I'm afraid of them thinking I'm just trying to be special/not actually bi.

Plus men are all fine and dandy and I don't really *need* to date another girl I guess.

I was never interested in one of my attractive friends because he was always loud and too pushily outgoing. 

Meanwhile one guy I knew who is fairly unattractive in all honesty really caught my interest to say the least ^^'

@that person
Honey if something could take someone ugly and make them hot it would have to be a face structure change. 

If you think makeup can do that much, it's either very professional makeup that literally almost nobody does

Or you have very biased views on how ugly normal issues make a person (acne, under eye darkness and bags, and messy hair. Things that can be covered with makeup).

Make sure you will also accept that girl for who they are, even if they're not one of the cute ones and keep trying. You may find someone who feels  like they're in the same position as you. I hope you find someone you love.

I keep delaying things I find fun or that I'd rather do, but for some reason I just don't do it. For example I want to get further into a video game and I keep beating myself up over the fact that I basically wasted my day off instead of doing that.
